### Submission Checklist
- [ ] Branch strictly follows the naming format: `<No>_<Product_Name>` (e.g., `01_Content_Idea_Generator`).
- [ ] Code is organized inside a dedicated folder or branch root with a clear `README.md`.
- [ ] A `requirements.txt` or `package.json` is provided.
- [ ] `.env.example` is provided (NO secret API keys are committed in code).
- [ ] Clear setup and execution instructions are included in the branch README.
